origin.description: Store a rounding level of 0, 1, or 2.
origin.usage: local({ old <- getNumericRounding(); setNumericRounding(2L); ans <- getNumericRounding(); setNumericRounding(old); ans })
origin.details: Store a rounding level of 0, 1, or 2.
origin.value: Set the level to 2 and read it back, then restore 0.
